help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi dekọọ ịhụ ọnwa m?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Tinye ụbọchị na ogologo oge ịhụ ọnwa gị.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Na kalenda ma ọ bụ na Akwụkwọ ndekọ kwa ụbọchị, dekọọ mgbe ịhụ ọnwa gị malitere, ogologo oge ọ na-adị, na oke ọbara. Ozi a na-ewu akụkọ nke gị ma na-enyere nlere anya ndị AWA na-egosi aka.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Enwere m ike idozi ụbọchị ịhụ ọnwa?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Dozie ụbọchị ma ọ bụrụ na nsochi gị agbanweela.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Ee. Dozie ụbọchị ahụ n'ime nsochi gị ka akụkọ gị bụrụ eziokwu banyere okirikiri ọnwa gị. Nlere anya nwere ike ịgbanwe dabere na ozi ọhụrụ echekwara.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Kedu ka a si agbakọ ịhụ ọnwa m na-esote?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Nlere anya dabere na akụkọ nke gị.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: AWA na-atụ anya ịhụ ọnwa gị na-esote, oge ịtụrụ ime na ovulation site n'akụkọ nke gị, ogologo okirikiri ọnwa gị, na ozi ị na-edekọ. Anaghị adabere naanị n'okirikiri ọnwa ụbọchị 28.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi soro oke ọbara m?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Dekọọ otú ọbara na-agbanwe.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Jiri Akwụkwọ ndekọ kwa ụbọchị dee oke ọbara ịhụ ọnwa gị. Nke a na-edebe akụkọ otú o si agbanwe n'okirikiri ọnwa gị dị iche iche.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Gịnị bụ ihe akara ndị dị na kalenda pụtara?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Ịhụ ọnwa, ịtụrụ ime, ovulation na kalenda Hijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Kalenda na-egosi ụbọchị ịhụ ọnwa ị dekọtara yana oge ịtụrụ ime na ovulation a tụrụ anya. Ọ bụrụ na akara ime mmụọ gbanyere, a pụkwara igosi ụbọchị Hijri n'akụkụ ụbọchị Gregorian.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.questio: Kedu ka m ga-esi mara oge m nwere ike ịtụrụ ime?
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Lee ụbọchị a tụrụ anya na ha bụ nke kachasị.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Na ụdị Ịnwa ịtụrụ ime, AWA na-egosi oge a tụrụ anya nke ịtụrụ ime dabere na ozi okirikiri ọnwa gị na akụkọ nke gị.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: Kedu ka a si atụ anya ovulation m?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Nlere anya na-agbanwe ka ị na-eso.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: A na-atụ anya ovulation site n'ozi dị n'akụkọ okirikiri ọnwa gị. Nlere anya a nwere ike ịgbanwe ka ị na-agbakwunye data ọhụrụ.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Enwere m ike soro okpomọkụ ahụ m n'ụra?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Tinye okpomọkụ gị n'nsochi ịtụrụ ime gị.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Ee. Nsochi okpomọkụ ahụ n'ụra bụ akụkụ nke ụdị ịnwa ịtụrụ ime.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.questio: Enwere m ike soro mucus cervical m?
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.subtitl: Tinye ihe a ị hụrụ n'nsochi ịtụrụ ime gị.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Ee. Nsochi mucus cervical bụ otu n'ime ozi dị na ụdị Ịnwa ịtụrụ ime.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Enwere m ike idekọ nyocha ovulation LH?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Debe nsonaazụ gị n'nsochi gị.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Ee. Idekọ nyocha ovulation LH bụ akụkụ nke njem ịnwa ịtụrụ ime.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi dekọọ mmekọ nwoke na nwanyị?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Nzuzo n'akwụkwọ ndekọ gị.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Mpaghara Nzuzo na-enye gị ohere idekọ mmekọ nwoke na nwanyị na ozi ndị ọzọ metụtara ya. Mpaghara a na-anọ n'nzuzo, a pụkwara ichebe ya iche.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Kedu ụzọ contraception m ga-esi soro?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Ọgwụ, ring, patch na ọgwụgwọ hormone.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: AWA na-akwado nsochi ọgwụ contraception, ring ukwu nwanyị, patch contraception, na ọgwụgwọ hormone ndị ọzọ.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.que: Enwere m ike ịtọ ncheta maka ọgwụ m?
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.sub: Tọọ ncheta ị nwere ike ịhazi.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Ee. AWA na-enye ncheta ị nwere ike ịhazi maka ị ṅụ ọgwụ gị, yana ọkwa kwa ụbọchị.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.qu: Enwere m ike idekọ ọgwụ echefuru?
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Ee. Isoro doses ị gafere bụ akụkụ nke njem contraception.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Ebee ka m ga-ahụ akụkọ ịṅụ ọgwụ m?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Lelee doses ị dekọtara na ọgwụ ị gafere.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Akụkọ ịṅụ ọgwụ dị iji debe ndekọ nsochi contraception gị.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Nlere anya ka bara uru mgbe m na-eji contraception?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Ụfọdụ ụzọ nwere ike ịgbanwe okirikiri ọnwa gị.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: AWA nwere ike ịga n'ihu na-egosi ozi nsochi dị, mana otú ị ga-esi ghọta nlere anya dabere n'ọnọdụ gị na ụzọ ị na-eji. App anaghị anọchi ndụmọdụ dọkịta.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: A na-ewere okirikiri ọnwa toro ogologo dị ka "igbu oge"?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: AWA na-atụle okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Mba. Na ụdị PCOS/Okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi, AWA anaghị ewere okirikiri ọnwa toro ogologo dị ka "igbu oge" n'onwe ya.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Kedu mgbaàmà m ga-esi soro na PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Lelee mgbaàmà na-agbanwe n'oge.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Nsochi gụnyere okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi, pimples, uto ntutu, mgbanwe ịdị arọ na mgbaàmà ndị ọzọ metụtara ya.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Enwere m ike soro pimples na uto ntutu?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Tinye ihe ị hụrụ n'nsochi PCOS gị.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Ee. Pimples na uto ntutu bụ akụkụ doro anya nke nsochi dabara na PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Enwere m ike soro mgbanwe ịdị arọ m?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Lelee otú ịdị arọ gị si agbanwe n'oge.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Ee. Nsochi ịdị arọ dị na ụdị PCOS/Okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Gịnị mere nlere anya m ji agbanwe karịa?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi na-eme ka nlere anya ghara iguzosi ike.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Mgbe okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi, nlere anya nwere ike ịgbanwe karịa n'ụzọ nkịtị. AWA na-eji akụkọ nke gị n'ewughị okirikiri ọnwa toro ogologo dị ka igbu oge.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Kedu mgbaàmà m nwere ike soro?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Nsochi dabara na mgbanwe nke oge ndụ a.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Nsochi gụnyere hot flashes, ọsụsọ abalị, nsogbu ụra, ike ọgwụgwụ, mgbanwe ọnọdụ obi na brain fog, n'etiti ndị ọzọ.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Enwere m ike idekọ hot flashes m?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Lelee ugboro ole ha na-eme n'oge.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Ee. Hot flashes bụ otu n'ime mgbaàmà dị na ụdị Perimenopause/Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Enwere m ike soro ụra m na ike ọgwụgwụ?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Lelee nsogbu ụra na ike ọgwụgwụ.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Ee. Nsogbu ụra, ọsụsọ abalị na ike ọgwụgwụ niile dị na njem a.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.qu: Enwere m ike soro ọgwụgwọ hormone?
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.su: Debe ozi bara uru n'nsochi gị.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Ee. Ị nwere ike soro ọgwụgwọ hormone dị ka akụkụ nke ụdị a.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Enwere m ike idekọ nsonaazụ FSH na estradiol m?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Tinye ụfọdụ nsonaazụ nyocha laabu n'nsochi gị.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Ee. A pụrụ idekọ nsonaazụ nyocha laabu dị ka FSH na estradiol n'ụdị a.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Kedu ka a si agbakọ ụbọchị m ga-amụ nwa?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Nlere anya gosiri n'nsochi ime gị.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Nsochi ime na-agbakọ ụbọchị a tụrụ anya na ị ga-amụ nwa site n'ozi dị n'nsochi gị.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Enwere m ike soro ime m izu site n'izu?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Lelee ọganihu ime gị izu site n'izu.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Ee. AWA na-enye nsochi izu site n'izu ma na-egosi otú ime gị si aga n'ihu.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Enwere m ike idekọ oge nzute m na dọkịta?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Debe oge nzute dị mkpa n'otu ebe.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Ee. Oge nzute na dọkịta na nyocha dị mkpa bụ akụkụ nke nsochi ime.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Enwere m ike nweta ncheta maka nyocha m?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Tọọ ncheta nke gị.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Ee. Ncheta nke onwe maka oge nzute na nyocha dị mkpa dị.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Gịnị ka m nwere ike soro n'oge ime m?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Mgbaàmà, ịdị arọ, ọnọdụ obi, ụra na ozi nke onwe.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Nsochi ime nwere ike ịgụnye mgbaàmà ị na-enwe, ịdị arọ, ọnọdụ obi, ụra na ozi ahụike nke onwe.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi soro lochia m?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Lelee ogologo oge na otú ihe na-apụ si agbanwe.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Nsochi mgbe a mụsịrị nwa gụnyere ogologo oge lochia, otú ọbara na-apụ si agbanwe, na mgbaàmà metụtara ya.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.questio: Kedu ka m ga-esi soro ịlọghachi nke ịhụ ọnwa m?
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.subtitl: Lelee otú okirikiri ọnwa gị na-alaghachi nwayọọ.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: AWA na-eso ịlọghachi nke okirikiri ọnwa gị, ịhụ ọnwa gị ịmalite ọzọ, na mgbanwe hormone gị mgbe ịmụsịrị nwa.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Enwere m ike soro ịra nwa ara na amenorrhea nke ịra ara?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Debe ozi a n'njem gị mgbe ịmụsịrị nwa.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Ee. Ịra nwa ara na amenorrhea mgbe a mụsịrị nwa bụ akụkụ nke nsochi dị.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Gịnị ka m nwere ike soro n'oge ahụ ike m na-esi ike?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Ike ọgwụgwụ, ụra, ọnọdụ obi, mgbu na ahụ ike ahụ.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Nsochi kwa ụbọchị mgbe a mụsịrị nwa gụnyere ike ọgwụgwụ, ụra, ọnọdụ obi, mgbu na ahụ ike ahụ, n'etiti ndị ọzọ.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: Kedu ka AWA si ejikwa nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Akara okpukpe, iche na nsochi ahụike.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Mgbe akara ime mmụọ gbanyere, AWA nwere ike soro ogologo oge ọbara na-apụ mgbe a mụsịrị nwa ma gosi ebe ntụaka nifas dabere na ntụaka okpukpe ahọpụtara. Oke ogologo oge nwere ike ịdị iche n'etiti ụlọ akwụkwọ echiche, a naghị egosi ya dị ka eziokwu otu n'ebe echiche dị iche.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi soro ọbara m?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Lelee otú ọ na-agbanwe, na-adịghị emerụ ọsọ ịlaghachi n'nsochi nkịtị.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Njem Mgbe ime wee dọpụ na-eso ọbara na otú ọ si agbanwe, n'ebe dabara n'oge a.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Kedu ka m ga-esi soro ịlọghachi nke okirikiri ọnwa m?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Malitegharịa nsochi gị n'ọsọ gị.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: AWA na-eso ịlọghachi nke okirikiri ọnwa gị mgbe ime dọpụrụ, na-ekwe ka ị nwayọọ were akụkọ gị ọzọ n'enweghị mmanye nsochi ịhụ ọnwa nkịtị ozugbo.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Kedu mgbaàmà m nwere ike idekọ?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Soro mgbaàmà ahụ ị chọrọ ide.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Nsochi mgbaàmà ahụ dị na njem a.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Enwere m ike idebe ihe edeturu nke onwe?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Ebe nke onwe n'akwụkwọ ndekọ gị.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Ee. Ihe edeturu nke onwe dị iji soro gị n'oge a.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Enwere m ike ịlọghachi na ịnwa ịtụrụ ime mgbe nke a gasịrị?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Gbanwee nzube gị mgbe ọ bụla ị chọrọ ịnwa ọzọ.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Nkwado maka ịmaliteghachi ịnwa ịtụrụ ime dị. Ịgbanwe nzube gị na-abụ nwayọọ, ọ bụkwa mgbe niile nhọrọ nke gị.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Kedu ka kalenda Hijri si arụ ọrụ?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Na-egosi ụbọchị Hijri n'akụkụ ụbọchị Gregorian.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Mgbe akara ime mmụọ gbanyere, AWA nwere ike igosi ụbọchị Hijri n'akụkụ ụbọchị Gregorian ma gosi ọnwa ndị dị mkpa dị ka Ramadan ma ọ bụ Dhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Gịnị ka ọnọdụ ịdị ọcha pụtara?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Akara nzuzo metụtara ịmaliteghachi ofufe okpukpe.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: AWA nwere ike igosi akara nzuzo na-ekewa ịhụ ọnwa gị na oge ịdị ọcha gị mgbe akara ime mmụọ gbanyere.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: Kedu ka AWA si egosi mgbe ekpere ga-amaliteghachi?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Akara dabere na mgbe ịhụ ọnwa gị kwụsịrị.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Ọ bụrụ na ịdị ọcha alọghachi tupu oge ekpere dị ugbu a agwụ, app nwere ike igosi na ekpere a alọghachila ịbụ nke ị ga-ekpe. A naghị agụ ekpere ndị ị gafere n'oge ịhụ ọnwa gị dị ka ekpere ị ga-emezu.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Kedu ka nsochi ibu ọnụ a ga-emezu si arụ ọrụ?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Na-agụ ụbọchị ị gafere n'ihi ịhụ ọnwa gị.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: AWA nwere ike inye ihe ọgụgụ maka ụbọchị ibu ọnụ ị gafere n'ihi ịhụ ọnwa gị, karịsịa n'oge Ramadan, yana obere ncheta mgbe ọnwa ahụ gasịrị ka ị hazie ịmezu ha.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: Kedu ka e si egosi nifas?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Akara nwere ike ịdị iche n'etiti ụlọ akwụkwọ echiche.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: AWA nwere ike igosi ntụaka okpukpe ahọpụtara maka oke ogologo oge nifas, na-ekwu ọdịiche n'etiti ụlọ akwụkwọ echiche ebe ọdịnaya akwadoro kpuchiri ha. App anaghị egosi otu ọnụọgụ dị ka eziokwu zuru oke.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: AWA na-enye ndụmọdụ gbasara istihada?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Ọdịnaya mmụta, ọ bụghị fatwa nke onwe.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: AWA nwere ike inye ọdịnaya mmụta n'ozuzu banyere istihada na ihe ọ pụtara maka ofufe. App anaghị enye fatwa nke onwe, a na-atụ anya ka ọkachamara a ma ama kwado ọdịnaya okpukpe.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Gịnị ka m nwere ike idekọ n'akwụkwọ ndekọ m?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Mgbaàmà, ọnọdụ obi, nzuzo, ụra na mmega ahụ.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: Akwụkwọ ndekọ kwa ụbọchị na-ekpuchi mgbaàmà ahụ, ọnọdụ mmetụta, nzuzo, ụra, mmega ahụ, na ihe edeturu nke onwe.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Mgbaàmà, ọnọdụ obi, ụra, mmega ahụ, ị ṅụ mmiri, ịhụ ọnwa na ihe edeturu.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: Akwụkwọ ndekọ kwa ụbọchị na-enye gị ohere soro mgbaàmà ahụ, ọnọdụ obi, ụra, mmega ahụ, ị ṅụ mmiri, oke ọbara ịhụ ọnwa, na ihe edeturu nke onwe.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: A pụrụ ichebe mpaghara Nzuzo m?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Mpaghara nzuzo, dị iche.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Ee. A pụrụ zoo mpaghara Nzuzo ma chebe ya na PIN ma ọ bụ Face ID nke ya, dị iche.
